source_evidence: Contributions are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes, but your investments can grow tax free and remain so when withdrawn if used for qualified disability expenses.
question: How are contributions and qualified withdrawals from an ABLE account treated for federal income tax purposes?
answer: Contributions to an ABLE account are not deductible for federal income tax purposes. Investments in the account can grow tax free, and withdrawals can remain tax free when used for qualified disability expenses.
